newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dongfeng Motor launches 100 mln yuan bonds.
newsitem.headline: Dongfeng Motor launches 100 mln yuan bonds.

text.p: Dongfeng Motor Corp, one of China's major automobile producers, said it had launched a 100 million yuan public corporate bond offer on Monday after receiving approval from the central People's Bank of China.
China Southern Securities has been appointed main underwriter for the offer, which should be completed by the end of this year, Dongfeng said in a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The three-year bonds, issued at a par value of one yuan per unit, carry an annual interest rate of 10.5 percent and will be listed on the Shenzhen bourse soon after completion, it said.
Dongfeng said it plans to use the bond proceeds to upgrade production technology.
Dongfeng, a state firm in the city of Shiyan in the central province of Hubei, makes trucks and cars, an official at Southern Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The trucks, under the Dongfeng brand, are mainly supplied to China's army, he said.
